reason: I already use LeetCode and my YouTuber's free playlists, so this feels like one more platform I would sign up for and forget. I rarely pay for study stuff, and INR 299 a month is a lot from my family's money.
objection: It is not clear it does anything LeetCode or the free playlists don't, and I have no proof the 'only what you have proven' plan will get me a job.
would_change_my_mind: A free trial that shows real DBMS and DSA quizzes plus a resume check that clearly finds problems in my own resume, so I can see it is better than what I already use.
